goal.en: Select a red object against a neutral or green background. The output is a binary mask of sufficiently large red regions.
goal.sl: Izberi rdeč predmet na nevtralnem ali zelenem ozadju. Rezultat je binarna maska dovolj velikih rdečih območij.

order.en: Extract the color channels, subtract green from red, then threshold. Opening removes isolated foreground pixels before component filtering measures the remaining connected regions.
order.sl: Razcepi barvne kanale, odštej zeleno od rdeče in nato uporabi prag. Odpiranje odstrani osamljene piksle, preden filtriranje povezanih območij izmeri preostale skupine.

tune.en: Start with threshold 0.20, opening size 3 and minimum area 100 pixels. Raise the threshold to reject weak redness; raise the area limit to reject small fragments.
tune.sl: Začni s pragom 0,20, velikostjo odpiranja 3 in najmanjšo površino 100 pikslov. Višji prag zavrne šibko rdečino; večja površina zavrne majhne delce.

expected.en: The supplied scene contains one large red rectangle, a green rectangle and small red specks. The final mask should keep only the large red rectangle.
expected.sl: Priložen prizor vsebuje velik rdeč pravokotnik, zelen pravokotnik in drobne rdeče pike. Končna maska ohrani samo velik rdeč pravokotnik.

caution.en: This is color segmentation, not object recognition. White balance, colored illumination and highlights change the difference. The threshold uses normalized float channels.
caution.sl: To je segmentacija barve, ne prepoznavanje vrste predmeta. Ravnovesje beline, barvna osvetlitev in odsevi spremenijo razliko. Prag uporablja normalizirane kanale.

lessons.formula:
S = R − G
M = 1[S > τ]
M₁ = (M ⊖ K) ⊕ K
O(p) = 1[p ∈ C ∧ |C| ≥ A_min]

sources.title: Joseph Howse, OpenCV Computer Vision with Python, Packt, 2013

goal.en: Separate bright parts from a dark background and reject tiny regions by their actual pixel area.
goal.sl: Loči svetle predmete od temnega ozadja in zavrni drobna območja glede na dejansko število pikslov.

order.en: Convert RGB to luminance, smooth small fluctuations, threshold, then filter connected regions. Area filtering comes after segmentation because it needs a binary foreground.
order.sl: Pretvori RGB v svetlost, zgladi manjša nihanja, uporabi prag in filtriraj povezana območja. Površino filtriramo po segmentaciji, ker potrebujemo binarno ospredje.

tune.en: Use Gaussian size 3 and sigma 1, threshold 0.60 and minimum area 80. Compare the threshold output with the final mask while raising the area limit.
tune.sl: Uporabi Gaussovo velikost 3 in sigmo 1, prag 0,60 in najmanjšo površino 80. Ob zviševanju površine primerjaj rezultat praga s končno masko.

expected.en: Two large bright parts remain. A dark hole inside a part stays a hole; it does not contribute to the foreground area. Tiny bright dots disappear.
expected.sl: Ostaneta dva velika svetla predmeta. Temna luknja znotraj predmeta ostane luknja in ne prispeva k površini ospredja. Drobne svetle pike izginejo.

caution.en: Eight-connectivity joins pixels touching at a corner. Touching physical objects can therefore become one region. Pixel area is not a calibrated physical area.
caution.sl: Osemsosednost poveže tudi piksle, ki se dotikajo v oglišču. Fizična predmeta, ki se dotikata, lahko postaneta eno območje. Površina v pikslih ni umerjena fizična površina.

sources.title: Joseph Howse, OpenCV Computer Vision with Python, Packt, 2013
Finding contours: segmentation precedes shape analysis

goal.en: Find regions whose color changed between consecutive frames from a fixed camera.
goal.sl: Poišči območja, katerih barva se je spremenila med zaporednima sličicama mirujoče kamere.

order.en: Keep signed channel differences, combine their magnitudes, threshold, remove isolated pixels, then reject small regions. A second frame is required before a difference exists.
order.sl: Ohrani predznačene razlike kanalov, združi njihove velikosti, uporabi prag, odstrani osamljene piksle in zavrni majhna območja. Za razliko potrebujemo drugo sličico.

tune.en: Start with magnitude threshold 0.12, opening size 3 and minimum area 40. Step through two frames, then compare the signed red difference with the magnitude and mask.
tune.sl: Začni s pragom velikosti 0,12, odpiranjem velikosti 3 in najmanjšo površino 40. Izvedi dve sličici in primerjaj predznačeno rdečo razliko z velikostjo in masko.

expected.en: The first processed frame is empty. Later frames show changed portions around the moving synthetic part, including its previous location.
expected.sl: Prva obdelana sličica je prazna. Naslednje pokažejo spremenjene dele ob premikajočem se sintetičnem predmetu, tudi na njegovi prejšnji lokaciji.

caution.en: This detects change, not identity or a full object silhouette. Camera motion, flicker and shadows also produce responses. Restarting the algorithm resets the previous frame.
caution.sl: To zaznava spremembo, ne identitete ali celotne silhuete predmeta. Premik kamere, utripanje in sence prav tako povzročijo odziv. Ponovni začetek algoritma ponastavi prejšnjo sličico.

lessons.formula:
ΔC = C(t) − C(t−1)
D = √(ΔR² + ΔG² + ΔB²)
M = 1[D > τ]

sources.title: Original SimpleMotocam exercise: signed channel differencing
Joseph Howse, OpenCV Computer Vision with Python, Packt, 2013

goal.en: Turn a grayscale edge map into a mask of long straight line segments.
goal.sl: Pretvori sivinsko karto robov v masko dolgih ravnih daljic.

order.en: Compute luminance and smooth it before Canny. Hough then groups edge pixels into candidate line segments. Thresholding a color region is a different task from finding its boundary.
order.sl: Izračunaj svetlost in jo zgladi pred Cannyjem. Hough nato združi robne piksle v kandidatne daljice. Pragovanje barvnega območja ima drugačen namen kot iskanje njegove meje.

tune.en: Use Gaussian size 3, Canny low 40 and high 100, Hough votes 30, minimum length 60 and maximum gap 5. Canny thresholds are in the quantized 8-bit gradient domain.
tune.sl: Uporabi Gaussovo velikost 3, Cannyjev spodnji prag 40 in zgornji 100, Houghove glasove 30, najmanjšo dolžino 60 in največjo vrzel 5. Cannyjeva pragova sta v kvantizirani 8-bitni domeni gradienta.

expected.en: Long straight features are retained while short isolated marks are rejected. A thick bright stripe may produce two boundary lines.
expected.sl: Dolge ravne značilnosti ostanejo, kratke osamljene oznake pa odpadejo. Debela svetla črta lahko povzroči dve robni daljici.

caution.en: A line mask is not a fitted physical dimension. Perspective, calibration and uncertainty must be addressed before metrology. More votes do not guarantee a more accurate line.
caution.sl: Maska daljic ni izmerjena fizična dimenzija. Pred meroslovjem je treba obravnavati perspektivo, kalibracijo in negotovost. Več glasov ne zagotavlja natančnejše daljice.

lessons.formula:
J = Gσ ⋆ Y
E = Canny(J, low, high)
ρ = x cos θ + y sin θ

sources.title: Emanuele Trucco & Alessandro Verri, Introductory Techniques for 3-D Computer Vision, Prentice Hall, 1998
Joseph Howse, OpenCV Computer Vision with Python, Packt, 2013

goal.en: Compare impulsive noise with coherent object boundaries using median filtering and a Laplacian response.
goal.sl: Z medianinim filtrom in Laplaceovim odzivom primerjaj impulzni šum s povezanimi mejami predmeta.

order.en: Convert to luminance, apply a small median filter, compute the signed Laplacian, take its absolute value, then threshold. Absolute value keeps both edge polarities.
order.sl: Pretvori v svetlost, uporabi majhen medianin filter, izračunaj predznačeni Laplaceov odziv, vzemi absolutno vrednost in uporabi prag. Absolutna vrednost ohrani obe polariteti roba.

tune.en: Start with median size 3 and response threshold 0.15. Inspect the signed Laplacian before the absolute-value block. Increase the median size to compare lost fine detail.
tune.sl: Začni z mediano velikosti 3 in pragom odziva 0,15. Pred blokom absolutne vrednosti preglej predznačeni Laplaceov odziv. Povečaj velikost mediane in primerjaj izgubo drobnih podrobnosti.

expected.en: Sparse salt-and-pepper pixels mostly disappear, while the rectangle boundary remains. This is a detection adaptation, not a copy of the book’s artistic outlining effect.
expected.sl: Redki črni in beli šumni piksli večinoma izginejo, rob pravokotnika pa ostane. To je prilagoditev za zaznavanje, ne kopija umetniškega učinka iz knjige.

caution.en: The Laplacian amplifies residual noise. Filtering can erase thin objects. This exercise uses float32, a size-3 median and a size-1 Laplacian stencil, unlike the book’s color effect.
caution.sl: Laplacian ojača preostali šum. Filtriranje lahko izbriše tanke predmete. Vaja uporablja float32, mediano velikosti 3 in Laplaceovo shemo velikosti 1, drugače kot barvni učinek v knjigi.

sources.title: Joseph Howse, OpenCV Computer Vision with Python, Packt, 2013
Emanuele Trucco & Alessandro Verri, Introductory Techniques for 3-D Computer Vision, Prentice Hall, 1998

goal.en: Extract dark marks on a slowly varying bright background using a local threshold.
goal.sl: Izloči temne oznake na počasi spreminjajočem se svetlem ozadju z lokalnim pragom.

order.en: Convert to luminance, smooth, use adaptive Gaussian thresholding, invert the result, then remove small regions. Inversion makes the dark marks the foreground.
order.sl: Pretvori v svetlost, zgladi, uporabi prilagodljivi Gaussov prag, obrni rezultat in odstrani majhna območja. Z obračanjem postanejo temne oznake ospredje.

tune.en: Start with adaptive window size 15, offset 5 and minimum area 50. The window must be odd and wider than the mark. The offset is in 8-bit intensity units.
tune.sl: Začni z oknom prilagodljivega praga 15, odmikom 5 in najmanjšo površino 50. Okno mora biti liho in širše od oznake. Odmik je v 8-bitnih enotah svetlosti.

expected.en: The two dark bars remain across the brightness gradient. Compare with a fixed threshold to see why the locally estimated background helps.
expected.sl: Temni letvi ostaneta kljub gradientu svetlosti. Primerjaj s fiksnim pragom, da vidiš korist lokalno ocenjenega ozadja.

caution.en: A window that is too small can detect only outlines or miss wide marks. Strong texture and sharp shadows can resemble defects. This is an illustrative inspection task, not a trained defect classifier.
caution.sl: Premajhno okno lahko zazna samo obrise ali izpusti široke oznake. Močna tekstura in ostre sence lahko spominjajo na napake. To je učna kontrolna naloga, ne naučen klasifikator napak.

lessons.formula:
T(x,y) = GaussianMean_window(J₈) − C
M = 1[J₈ > T]
D = 1 − M
